no_conversations.what: The agent summarizes your conversations with your personas, and there were none to read when it started.
fix: Define at least one target persona in the persona section of this stage and save it.
Click "Launch a chat with the Persona" and exchange a few messages about your idea.
Come back to this stage and click "Run the agent again".

token_limit_reached.what: The agent stopped before its next step because a token limit was reached.
fix: Open Settings → Token Usage Setting to see how many tokens this idea and your organization have used.
Ask your organization's administrator to raise the limit.
Once it's raised, click "Run the agent again".

limit_reached.what: The agent reached the most it may do in one run before it finished.
fix: Make sure your personas are specific (age range, demographic, income) so there is less to work out.
Keep the persona conversations focused on the questions that matter most.
Click "Run the agent again". If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

agent_error.what: Something went wrong while the agent was working, so it stopped and saved nothing.
fix: Wait a minute, then click "Run the agent again"; most of these problems are temporary.
If the same message appears again, tell your administrator (they can check the AI service's account, key and quota).

interrupted.what: The server restarted while the agent was working, so the run was lost.
fix: Click "Run the agent again". Your personas and chats are safe.

no_result.what: The agent finished its steps without producing the persona insights.
fix: Check that your persona chats contain real answers from the personas.
Click "Run the agent again".

location_required.what: The agent needs your country and city to work.
fix: Add your country and city on Stage 6 (Market Evidence) and save.
Click "Run the agent again".

venture_archived.what: The venture was archived while the agent was working, so it was stopped.
fix: Restore the venture from My ventures → Archived ventures to work on it again.

stopped_by_user.what: The agent was stopped with the Stop (Cancel) button before it finished. Nothing was saved.
fix: Click "Run the agent again" when you're ready.

unknown.what: The agent stopped for a reason the app doesn't recognize.
fix: Click "Run the agent again".
If it stops again, tell your administrator.

why.scopeVenture: For this venture idea (set by your administrator in Settings → Token Usage Setting).
why.scopeOrganization: For your whole organization (set by your administrator in Settings → Token Usage Setting).
why.scopeRun: For a single run of the agent (a fixed safety limit per run).
